records.finding: Windows DirEntry.stat returned zero link count for ordinary source files
records.observed_result: Four snapshot-dependent inherited tests errored during the first implementation run
records.resolution: Use Path.lstat to obtain native file identity and link counts; keep multiply linked file rejection
records.regression: Inherited snapshot and mocked orchestration tests passed after correction

records.finding: Windows Job ActiveProcesses became zero before descendant process handles signaled termination
records.observed_result: Two of eleven new platform tests failed in the first native run; immediate descendant liveness checks remained true
records.resolution: Retain process synchronization handles before termination and require both zero active members and signaled handles before confirmed cleanup
records.regression: All eleven new tests passed after correction, including parent exit, timeout, and supervisor hard death

records.finding: Native symbolic link creation lacks Windows privilege
records.observed_result: Inherited symlink fixture raised WinError 1314 before exercising admission
records.resolution: Skip only this precise unavailable-privilege condition and retain explicit HOLD for native symlink qualification
records.separate_evidence: Actual Windows junction-to-protected-host fixture is rejected; junction target sentinel remains unchanged

scope: Software defect and controlled native process/filesystem evidence; not Docker containment or general intelligence evidence
